serial.integration_and_delivery: Because no implementation files were produced, no integration, module assembly, or deliverable placement happened; artifact validation found no expected entry file.

outcome_analysis.explanation: The official outcome is both_fail, not discordant: both completed evaluations report solution_passed false with 0/140 passed samples. Parallel's distinctive adverse process was the completed probing swarm followed by a late whole-task coder child that was stopped before producing files. Serial failed differently by keeping all probing and planning in one actor and never beginning file creation. Because neither delivered an artifact, the retained parallel pattern explains a harmful coordination episode but not a pass/fail split.

ordinary_implementation_differences: Neither run reached a concrete JS implementation, so no ordinary code-level defect differentiates the official scores.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: No outcome difference; the retained label describes a directly evidenced parallel adverse process, not an exclusive root cause.
